# Remove-ZbxTemplateDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Removes template dashboards.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxTemplateDashboard [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateDashboard>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template dashboard is a dashboard a template defines; each host linked to the template shows it with that host's data. The Remove-ZbxTemplateDashboard cmdlet deletes the template dashboards given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with templatedashboard.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a template dashboard

```powershell
Remove-ZbxTemplateDashboard -InputObject 'Web App overview' -Confirm:$false
```

Deletes the template dashboard Web App overview. -Confirm:$false skips the prompt the command shows by default.

### Example 2: Preview deleting the template dashboards a search finds

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard -Name 'Web*' | Remove-ZbxTemplateDashboard -WhatIf
```

Lists the template dashboards whose names start with Web that the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
